Hi Lauren,

Thanks for taking this as part of the ProcureWorks RFP. Attached is our SIG v2 questionnaire — see tab 'Must Haves' for the controls we need substantiation for in the short window. Our procurement team has requested a clear plan for which controls you can substantiate with artifacts and a timeline for delivery.

Questions we have up front:
- Can you provide a control ownership map (who owns each control at Redwood and what evidence will be supplied)?
- Are there any controls that will require redaction/legal review or that you will not be able to substantiate with customer-specific artifacts?
- Can you commit to an evidence delivery window (we are targeting a curated bundle by Jul 29 to meet our security review on Aug 2)?

If useful we can kick off a short call to triage priorities. Please let me know who on your side will be the point of contact for evidence collection.

Best,
Emily Frost
Head of Vendor Risk, ProcureWorks
